description: This source file defines the PlatformSpecificContent class, which manages the activation of content based on the build target platform (e.g., mobile vs desktop) within Unity. It includes platform-specific logic, editor hooks for updating in the Unity Editor, and provides mechanisms to enable or disable GameObjects and MonoBehaviours depending on the platform.

classes.name: PlatformSpecificContent
classes.description: Manages enabling and disabling content depending on target platform, with Unity Editor integration for update-based content toggling.

methods.name: CheckEnableContent
methods.description: Checks the current build target platform and enables or disables content accordingly.

methods.name: EnableContent
methods.description: Activates or deactivates specified content GameObjects and MonoBehaviours based on the given enabled flag.

methods.name: OnActiveBuildTargetChanged
methods.description: Callback invoked when the active build target changes in Unity Editor.

methods.name: Update
methods.description: Periodically checks whether content should be enabled or disabled during editor updates.
